name: Nishi-Nippori
tagline: Otemachi in 13 minutes and Tokyo in 14 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Arakawa City, where JR East, Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 13 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 30 minutes to Shibuya and 28 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 12.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 19.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 12.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4 m to 23.2 m, a difference of 19.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 19 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is はせがわ病院, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立駒込病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. Nippori-Toneri Liner are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines, Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 町屋→西日暮里, which includes this station. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. Nippori-Toneri Liner is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nippori is ahead on the number of lines, but Nishi-Nippori is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nishi-Nippori.

neighbours.lead: Sendagi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Nishi-Nippori is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Nishi-Nippori. One-room rents run about ¥7,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 道灌山通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
尾久橋通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 16 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
